messages:
Kara (Partnerships): Velox (hardware partner) wants a LangChain + Redwood adapter listed in the marketplace. Theyre asking for a joint launch in July. Need quick owners for spec, sample app, and marketplace gating.
Diego (Product): Ill take the spec + gating checklist. Target: marketplace approval checklist done by 2026-06-12. We need eng ETA and a sample app owner.
Alex (Eng-Platform): Minimal deliverable: auth + device discovery shim + smoke tests. Estimate 2 sprints for M1. We'll require quantized model artifacts from Velox to validate.
Rina (DevEx): I can build a LangChain quickstart and a small tutorial for Dedicated/Private routing. ETA 4 business days after sandbox creds.
Velox (Partner): We will provide sandbox endpoints, device images, and a firmware compatibility table by Tue. We also need a co-marketing brief and proposed embargo window of 10 days pre-announce.
Alex (Eng-Platform): Technical ask: can Velox share supported CUDA/cuDNN versions and whether they expose device telemetry via REST or gRPC? That affects the shim.
Velox (Partner): We'll share versions and a gRPC telemetry endpoint.
LegalBot: Flagging export control review for hardware. Send NDA addendum; expect 3 business days.
CommsBot: Suggested launch milestone: internal beta -> 2 customer pilots -> marketplace listing -> joint press. Draft comms timeline in spec doc.
Kara (Partnerships): Action items: Diego = spec + checklist; Alex = runtime shim + tests; Rina = quickstart; Velox = sandbox + telemetry details; LegalBot = contract review. I'll schedule a 30-min sync Fri 9am PT. Reply with :white_check_mark: if you can make it.
